title: Ngeli ya U-YA (Theme 6: Maadili)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 5 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child knows nouns of U-YA take u- for one and ya- for many, and their plural takes ma- (ugonjwa -> magonjwa, uso -> nyuso is not U-YA).
representations: a U-ZI and U-YA sorting chart
steps: If so, U-YA: u- and ya-.

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes "Unyoya umeanguka" and "Manyoya yameanguka".

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Manyoya ___meanguka." Kwa nini "zi" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Nomino za U-YA zina wingi wenye ma-, na zinapatana na ya-: manyoya yameanguka.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Wingi wa "unyoya" ni ___." Kwa nini "minyoya" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Wingi wa nomino za U-YA huundwa kwa ma-: unyoya - manyoya, ugonjwa - magonjwa, uchungu - machungu.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ugonjwa wake ___meisha." Kwa nini "ya" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Umoja wa ngeli ya U-YA hupatana na u-: ugonjwa umepona.
Ugonjwa ni wa U-YA: wingi ni magonjwa, na kitenzi huchukua ya-.
